regime: Tech-led selloff with rising volatility, while metals rebound and oil slumps on peace hopes
takeaway: Tech stocks fell again on AI-spending worries, pulling the Nasdaq down about 1.1%, and the VIX jumped about 9% to just above 21. Gold and silver bounced back from Friday's one-year lows, with gold up about 1.9% and the miners up even more, while Brent dropped nearly 8% on hopes of US–Iran talks. The midterms are today and the jobs report is Friday, so volatility may stay high.
